title: Data Visualisation & Dashboards
summary: P2 teaches you to choose the right chart, design it so the point is obvious, and build interactive dashboards that answer a manager’s questions at a glance.
prereq: Builds on C1 · Excel Foundations and C2 · Formulas & Functions. P1’s PivotTables module helps with Module 6.
outcomes: Pick the right chart for a comparison, trend, composition, distribution or relationship.
Remove clutter and use colour and labels so the point lands at a glance.
Build combo, waterfall, histogram, Pareto, box-and-whisker, funnel, treemap and map charts.
Make charts interactive with drop-downs, form controls and dynamic ranges.
Show patterns inside cells with conditional formatting, sparklines and icons.
Plan, design and build a one-page dashboard.
Present findings with clear titles, accessible design and safe sharing.

lessons.title: What a chart is for
lessons.summary: A chart answers one question for one audience with one message. Decide those first, write the message as the title, and know when a table does the job better.
objectives: Say the question a chart answers, who it is for and the one message it carries.
Tell a chart made to explore data from one made to explain it.
Write a title that states the finding, not the topic.
Decide when a table serves the reader better than a chart.
